bounties.title: Index taps
bounties.blurb: Thumb to index taps with the hand raised and pointing at lit buttons, as with the hand ray: arm out and bent, two windows, high and low, far away, both hands, near misses and holds.

bounties.title: Middle taps
bounties.blurb: Thumb to middle finger taps (right clicks) with the hand raised and pointing, mixed with index taps so the two can be told apart.

bounties.title: Pinches
bounties.blurb: Pinch a window's bar or corner and drag, resize, tilt and stretch it to a ghost outline.

bounties.title: Three-finger grabs
bounties.blurb: Grab a window's edge like a playing card: hold it, place it, push it away, throw it.
